stem.text: The graph shows the decrease in cases of tuberculosis (TB) in a country between 1910 and 2000.

stem.alt: Graph of number of cases per year against year from 1910 to 2000, with the number of cases falling over the period.

stem.text: Which factors could have contributed to the fall over this period?

items: the provision of new housing to reduce overcrowding
removing large pools of stagnant water
identification of contacts of people infected with TB
